about.style: short melodic electro / house test loop, minor-key
about.engine: Tunefish 4: PADsynth-style wavetable generator with unison layers, band noise, ladder/RBJ filters, distortion, delay, reverb, EQ
about.description: A short 26-bar demo module: hats, a 16th-note pluck and an 8th-note arp play from bar 1, a lead pluck, kick and snare join at bar 9, and a low bass enters for the last section (bars 17-25). The pitches centre on F (F, G, A-flat, B-flat, C, E-flat), giving a minor feel.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: noise only, band 8.3-16.6 kHz, very short envelope
about.description: 8th-note hats through the whole loop (bars 1-25). A fairly wet small-room reverb (wet 0.48) softens them.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: one octave up, sparse harmonics with phase modulation, 3 unison layers, ladder low-pass 5 kHz, short decay
about.description: Repeats F3 in 16ths with occasional higher notes up to B-flat4, from bar 1 to bar 25. A long-feedback delay (decay 0.68) and reverb blur it into a rhythmic bed.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: full-harmonic table two octaves down, 4 unison layers, ladder low-pass 3.4 kHz
about.description: An 8th-note line mostly on F in the first octave, played only in the final section (bars 17-25). Dry, with no effects.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: one octave up, 8 unison layers, open ladder low-pass 11.6 kHz, slow attack, very slow 0.064 Hz LFO on the layer count
about.description: An arpeggio over C, E-flat, F and B-flat across C3-B-flat4, bars 1-25. A long delay (0.45, decay 0.65) and reverb make it the main atmosphere.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: 9 unison layers with drive, open ladder low-pass 14.5 kHz, decaying envelope
about.description: A melodic 8th-note line in F3-C4 from bar 9 to the end. Stereo delay and a wide, damped reverb follow it.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: fixed-frequency generator (about 48 Hz) with a fast envelope pitch drop, band noise 174 Hz-3.9 kHz, ladder low-pass 1.28 kHz, power distortion 0.36
about.description: Plays on every beat from bar 9 to the end. Distortion adds punch and a compact reverb gives it some room.

about.engine: Tunefish 4: fixed 180 Hz tone with a pitch envelope plus noise up to 7.5 kHz, resonant RBJ high-pass 174 Hz, distortion 0.22, 3-band EQ
about.description: Two hits per bar from bar 9, with a pattern variant from bar 17. A damped, wide reverb sits behind it.
